method: Consensus of three measurers (gradient, segmentation, visual; segmentation shifted -0.5 px to pixel-centre coordinates): per row and field the median of the available values (mean of two), a value only where at least two report one; then every view overlaid at 3x-12x (contrast-stretched where the lit floor meets the legs) and the rows that looked off or disagreed by >4 px settled by re-measuring half-way crossings in luminance or warmth (R-B); landmarks are medians, head polygons are vertex-matched medians, per-corner radii from a ray fit of the rounded outline. Pixel centres at integers.

cornerRadii.order: same order as the vertices; ray-fit of the rounded outline to edge points (rms 0.2-0.4 px); null = corner hidden by the neck/shoulders

front.note: Half-widths from centreX, the mean of the left and right sides of the front and back views together, i.e. (right-left)/2 averaged over both views, so they do not depend on centreX. armInner/torso are the crease's two edges, slit the half-gap between the legs. The symmetric arm ends at armEndY (mean of the four arm ends, 615.6): at y 616 the back view's arm sliver is replaced by its hip edges.

notes: INPUTS: all three result files read and well formed. Conventions differ: gradient and visual put pixel centres at integers; segmentation uses continuous coordinates (pixel i spans [i,i+1)), so 0.5 was subtracted from every segmentation position (rows, centreX, crown/ground, head vertices, y landmarks; not widths or radii). After that the three agree to ~0.1-0.5 px on most rows. All numbers here are pixel-centre coordinates. | RULE: median of available values (mean of two). A row value is given only where at least two measurers give one; this drops single-measurer rows (the crease's soft top at 440-448 from gradient alone; side armFront 424/432; side armBack 416/424). Exceptions, each re-checked on the image: front 612 torsoLeft 86.5 (visual's hip edge, needed because the left arm still reaches row 612), back 616 armInnerLeft 860.12 (gradient's) and torsoLeft 881.8 (re-measured), side armBack 592/596 (gradient's), 3/4L 776 left 402.45. Full list in 'decisions'. | CHECKED BY OVERLAY: outer edges, creases, slit and head polygons sit on the true edges in all five views at 3x and in 5x-12x crops of the head, neck, arm ends, crotch, feet and side arm. Upper-body outer edges were also re-scanned automatically: every one is within 1.2 px of a local half-way crossing; only foot rows (>=736 on the front left leg, >=764 elsewhere) and the arm ends' tangent rows have too little contrast for that test, and those were checked by eye. | SIDE VIEW: faces image-left (front = belly = left edge), confirmed by all three. The arm's back edge is the faint line 5-11 px inside the back outline; the back outline from the shoulder down to y~596 is the TORSO's back, not the arm (visual read it as the arm). So armDepthSide 97.66 (mean of gradient 97.33 and segmentation 97.99) and torsoDepthSideMax 135.03 at y 512 is the torso's own depth (belly to upper back). armFront starts at 436, armBack at 428; above that the arm merges into the shoulder. Below y~690 the far leg peeks 3-7 px ahead of the near leg down to ~768, and side 'front' follows it there; legDepthSide 108.97 is the near leg. Side neck: 74.6 deep at y~371 (rows: 75.1 at 372). | HEAD: front 171.9 wide at y 300 (x 98.2-270.1), crown 221.36 to underside 369.56 = 148.2 tall; side 144.1 deep at y 304 (x 646.2-790.3); 3/4L about 163 wide. Polygons are 7-gons ordered clockwise on screen from the crown. Side polygon: its front and upper-front vertices come from segmentation and visual only; gradient fitted a different 7-gon (one bowed upper-front side, plus an underside vertex at (713.9, 358.3) that is the near shoulder's outline, not the head). The two bottom vertices of each polygon are hidden where the head meets the neck/shoulders (side: the bottom is the line through the neck notches). cornerRadius is the measurers' median (front 33.21, side 37.0); per-corner ray fits (head.cornerRadii) give front crown 50.5, upper corners 36.5/37, sides 32/36; side crown 31, upper-back 39.5, back 56.5, front 46, upper-front 74.5 (155 deg, barely a corner); 3/4L crown 43.5, others 32.5-38.5. With one radius of 33.2 the rounded front crown sits ~1.1 px above the measured crown; the crown wants ~50. A joint single-radius fit gives front 37, side 35.5, 3/4L 36.5, but the outline moves only 0.05 px rms between 33 and 37 (obtuse 125-140 deg corners), so the radius is weakly fixed by the image. | NECK: only a ~6 px waist where the head's lower corners meet the shoulder line: front 94.78 wide at the notches (y 363; x 136.3-231.5), back 92.1, side 74.6; neckBottomY 369.0, headBottomY 369.56 (front underside; segmentation's 370.7 is the centre of the dark underside crease). | CREASES: soft shading from ~440 (depth ~10 levels), >=20 levels by ~448, half its full depth at 460-462 (armpitY 460.5, the median; segmentation's 449 used a 15-level threshold), full depth ~470. Gradient reports the crease centre for both armInner and torso, segmentation and visual its two half-depth crossings (core 2.4-3 px), so the consensus crease is ~1-1.5 px narrower than the two-crossing readings. Below ~600 the arm's rounded inner-bottom corner lifts off the hip and the two values become the arm's and the hip's own outlines. | ARM ENDS (lowest point of each arm's rounded end, medians): front left 614.4, front right 615.5, back left 616.1, back right 616.5, side 612.75, 3/4L far 609.6 / near 612.7, 3/4R near 616.5 / far ~611; armEndY 615.04 is the front mean, 615.6 with the back. Contrast there is only 3-15 levels: +-1 px in y, +-3 px in x along the flat bottom. Arm width (outer edge to crease, front) peaks on a plateau y 528-548: left 80.8, right 78.3 (back 82.1/76.3); armWidthFrontWidest 79.56 at armWidestY 539.5 (visual's 563 was where the whole silhouette is widest, a different quantity). Widest silhouette: front 322.5 at y 560-564 (x 17.1-339.7), back 321.7 at 564. | LEGS AND FEET: slit opens at 619.4-619.9 (crotchY 619.43; gradient's 618.4 is the top of the dark shading above it), 1-1.5 px wide at 620-640, ~10 px at 700, ~28 px at 772. Leg width (one leg, outer edge to slit edge) mean of the four legs front+back: 94.9 at y 624, 100.5 at 704-712 (max), 99.0 at 740, 96.9 at 752, then the foot corners; front only 95.4, 101.1, 99.5. legWidthTop 95.43 (front, y 624), legWidthBottom 99.2 (y ~740, above the corner rounding). footCornerRadius 28.63; a re-fit of the four outer foot corners from the consensus rows gives 27.5-29.3 (mean 28.3). | GROUND: groundY is the lowest point of the dark contact line under each view's lowest foot. Per foot: front left 781.25, right 782.28; back 782.85/782.88; side near foot 784.9 (far foot hidden, ends ~767-777); 3/4L far 776.1, near 784.6; 3/4R near 782.9, far 778.3. The camera looks slightly down: nearer feet sit lower and contact lines curve, so the last row of each view cuts the contact line and is not a leg width. | SYMMETRY (left minus right of the outer edges about centreX, px; image left/right): front head -6.77 (max 12.1), shoulders 0.03 (max 5.17), arms 4.41 (max 5.84), legs 1.23 (max 1.84); back head -4.25, shoulders 0.67, arms 2.72, legs 0.42. These are mostly offsets, not shape: region midpoints front head 184.58, shoulders 181.18, arms 179, legs 180.58 vs centreX 181.2; back 977.88/975.42/974.39/975.54 vs 975.75. Both views shift the head to image-right and the arms to image-left, and the image-left arm is wider in both (front 80.8/78.3, back 82.1/76.3); a real 3D asymmetry would flip sides between front and back, so this is a skew of the render, and symmetric.front holds the averaged half-widths. The crown vertex (187.5) is 3 px right of the head's own centre (184.5): the head polygon's top is skewed too; mirror it about x 184.5 for a symmetric head. | 3/4 VIEWS: centreX is the silhouette midpoint (median of the three), not the turning axis; the head midpoints are 469.5 (3/4L) and 1274.4 (3/4R). | LEAST CERTAIN: foot rows >=772 and the foot corners (+-2 px); slit at 776-780 (+-3 px); arm-end bottoms (+-1 px y, +-3 px x); side far-leg front at 744-768 (+-2.5 px); side armBack (a 3-8 level line, +-1 px); the head's hidden bottom vertices and all head corner radii; armpitY (440-462 depending on the depth threshold). | HINTS THAT WERE WRONG: crown is 221.4-221.9 (row 220 is empty in every view); ground is 781-785, not 780; the back view spans 813.0-1134.7, not 808-1138; the arms end at 614-616.5, not 600-612; the front head is 171.9 wide, not 173; the crease shows faintly from ~440 and is sharp only from ~458, not 445. Confirmed: column ranges of the other views, the slit start (619.4-619.9), the side view facing left.
